column1: # comment: "Music extension alignments to external music ontologies, symbolic encoding standards, and Wikidata. All bridges are by reference (Principle 5)."

column6: comment
Wikidata 'aleatoric music' (Q623715) — the GMEOW relator declares the same indeterminacy structurally.
Wikidata 'time signature' (Q155234) — a CMN projection of the underlying MetricStructure.
PROV-O Association is the generic qualified participation idiom.
Wikidata 'scale' (Q179651) — broader than the GMEOW collection view.
Wikidata 'musical notation' (Q233861) — broader than the GMEOW pitch-spelling view.
Wikidata 'pitch class' (Q1760309) — a pitch value under octave equivalence.
Wikidata 'tempo' (Q189214) — the broad concept; GMEOW models tempo as a piecewise frame mapping.
Wikidata 'musical tuning' (Q723441) — broader than the GMEOW reference-frame view.
Wikidata 'musical improvisation' (Q1049625) — improvisation is one form of performer-delegated determination.
Wikidata 'concert' (Q182832).
Music Ontology mo:performance relates a performance event to the musical work performed.
Wikidata 'recording or performance of' (P2550) — the closest available property for performance→work linkage.
Wikidata 'Arabic maqam' (Q12826678) is narrower than the GMEOW maqam kind, which spans Arabic and Turkish traditions.
Wikidata 'mode (music)' (Q731978).
Wikidata 'raga' (Q216926).
Wikidata 'polymeter' (Q2102956) — in GMEOW polymeter is modelled as the concurrent MeterAssignment pattern, not as a class.
Wikidata 'musical ensemble' (Q2088357) — the entity an ensemble member participates in.
schema.org performer — already bridged from the events slice; repeated here for the music alignment set.
Wikidata 'tuplet' (Q2092296) — a tuplet is one kind of rational TimeMapping.
Wikidata '12 equal temperament' (Q752518).
Wikidata 'Bohlen–Pierce scale' (Q11901664).
Wikidata 'pelog' (Q1094781).
Wikidata 'Pythagorean tuning' (Q1045756).
Wikidata 'slendro' (Q431434).
